$note: Machine half of the diagram-type catalog. Read by svg_check.py's `diagram` check class and by validate.mjs, which fails the build if any slug here is absent from the skill's frontmatter. The prose half is reference/diagrams.md + reference/types/<slug>.md; the three must agree slug-for-slug. Entries are alphabetical. Budgets are ported from cathrynlavery/diagram-design (MIT) SKILL.md section 7; where that table names a per-type ceiling in the type's own vocabulary and that vocabulary maps onto a data-* attribute, the ceiling is written as an override here rather than left in prose. Every key here is READ by svg_check.py — a key nothing reads is a claim of enforcement that is not true, which is why `label_gap_max` was removed rather than left sitting beside `label_gap_min`: the checker measures a label against every connector in the file, so it cannot honestly say a label is too FAR from the one it belongs to. The 6-10 authoring range lives in reference/diagram-grammar.md section 7, as prose, where it belongs, and `attach_gap_min` went the same way for the same reason. `plotted` marks the five types whose node IS the datum: a gantt bar's x and width, a scatter point's cx and cy, are the measurement, so the 4-unit grid is not enforced on their nodes -- rounding them would move the number the chart exists to report. The skeleton is not a node and is still checked.
